'''Fume Pachoola''' was a wealthy [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Noble/Legends|aristocrat]] who lived during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Due to his [[Fume Pachoola's grandfather|grandfather]] having amassed a large fortune, Fume never had to work and he lived a life of luxury. He was the father to [[Pelf Pachoola]] and after she became engaged, he gave her two [[Kobarian swamp dog]]s, [[Higgs]] and [[Twiggs]], as a wedding present. After Fume and Pelf undertook a cruise aboard the [[Luxury liner/Legends|liner]] ''[[Salin Mariner]]'', they were kidnapped and held hostage by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]]. However, Fume refused to pay the pirate anything and the Weequay was unable to secure a ransom for their release, so he eventually let the Wroonians go, by forcing a passing delivery [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to take them off his hands.
